questions.question:
Resumen antes de redactar la especificación:

DECIDIDO
• Nuevos endpoints POST /listings/:id/pause y POST /listings/:id/resume; una pausada tiene status `paused`, una reanudada vuelve a `active`.

• Los pedidos abiertos existentes no se tocan.
• Errores con el estilo actual de la API ({"error": "codigo"} + 4xx).

FUERA DE ALCANCE

ABIERTO (se marcará para aclarar)
• Cómo encuentra el vendedor sus publicaciones pausadas para reanudarlas (hoy solo por id).

TAMAÑO (mi clasificación, corrígela si no coincide): estándar — agrega un estado y un flujo nuevos (hasta 3 rondas de revisión por fase).

questions.question:
Este es el prompt (en inglés) que le pasaré a la fase de especificación, completo y literal:

---
Feature: Pause and resume a listing

WHY: Sellers on the marketplace want to temporarily take a listing off the market without losing the ranking it has earned, and put it back later.

WHAT:
- Add two operations to the listings API: `POST /listings/:id/pause` and `POST /listings/:id/resume`. Both must be reachable through the API's published routes.
- A paused listing has status `paused`. Resuming a paused listing sets its status back to `active`.
- Who may pause and resume: the seller who owns the listing, and any admin. Anyone else (other sellers, buyers) is refused; an unidentified caller is refused as unauthenticated.
- Ranking: pausing and resuming do not change the listing's rank score. On resume the listing has exactly the score it had when paused; its position among other listings may differ if others gained orders meanwhile.
- While paused:
  - it does not appear in search results (`GET /listings`) for anyone;
  - its detail (`GET /listings/:id`) still answers anyone, showing status `paused`;
  - it refuses new orders (`POST /listings/:id/orders`).
- Repeated or no-op actions: pausing an already-paused listing, or resuming an already-active one, succeeds and returns the listing unchanged.
- Orders already open on a listing when it is paused are left untouched and stay visible in `GET /orders`.
- Errors follow the API's existing style (standing decision S2): a JSON body `{ "error": "<snake_case_code>" }` with a 4xx status; exact codes and success bodies are the implementer's choice. An unknown listing id answers not found.

Standing decisions: this feature sets aside, for this feature only, S1 ("Only admins change a listing's status") and S3 ("A listing has a single status, `active`"). Both remain binding for the rest of the project; this feature is the only exception.

Surfaces in scope: `POST /listings/:id/pause`, `POST /listings/:id/resume`, `GET /listings`, `GET /listings/:id`, `POST /listings/:id/orders`, the published route table.
Surfaces out of scope: `GET /orders` (unchanged), `POST /listings` (new listings still start `active`).

Non-goals: changing S1 or S3 project-wide; any other status (archived, deleted, sold out); notifications; cancelling or altering existing orders; a "my listings" endpoint unless the open decision below decides otherwise; scheduled/automatic pausing.

References: none.

Literals (carry these into the spec exactly as written; do not translate or reword them):
- `POST /listings/:id/pause`
- `POST /listings/:id/resume`
- `paused`
- `active`

Open decisions (do not resolve these; mark each `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]`):
- How does a seller find their paused listings in order to resume them? Search hides paused listings for everyone, including the owner, and no "my listings" endpoint exists; today they can only be reached by id.
---
